digest.component_or_area: development process audit reconciliation and recommendation disposition
propositions: The source audit's six process recommendations must be evaluated against prior audits, janitor remediations, architecture decisions, and implementation tickets to identify conflicting choices, already-completed work, and genuinely new evidence warranting reconsideration.

Escaped-defect metadata (detected_by) was already implemented as zero-friction optional tagging at creation; coverage is 1.1% but the mechanism works; refinement should expand stamping at known automated boundaries and measure by creation_channel, not require global schema changes.

Deterministic plan preflight has an existing P1-P11 floor from prior cost/churn analysis; further extension should depend only on recurrent mechanically-decidable failure classes with demonstrated false-positive ceilings and offline replay validation, not generic framework additions.

Completion-failure classification requires offline historical analysis of 351+ existing FAIL sidecars to derive stable reason codes and validate classifier agreement before adding durable schema; treating all non-PASS outcomes as code defects is invalid because they span implementation, ACs, evidence, planning, environment, and tool failures.

Risk-tiered review should pilot reporting without merge enforcement on signals available at review time (security/store/concurrency surfaces, file impact, complexity, plan-review history, diff breadth); blocking should require prospective defect measurement by tier and validation of precision before threshold adoption.

Human-review breadth, reviewer rotation, and required-with-override governance are inapplicable to this autonomous agentic project; the actual remaining problems are distinguishing author-model from reviewer-model provenance, monitoring provider diversity and correlated failures, and testing secondary recovery paths for critical dependencies.
